barRaise.topFinding: The app is in the best shape of the series and the loop that watches it skipped a day. Everything app-side re-verifies clean: all three suites pass (71 render, 31 migration, 9 integrity checks), both hard_rule_checks pass with the three pills agreeing at v1.1.4, and the deploy mirror is byte-identical on index.html, src/, data/, and styles/ for the second consecutive run. What did not happen is the 2026-07-29 bar-raise. The registry shows bar-raise-apothecary recording lastRunAt 2026-07-29T12:10:46Z, and it left no docs/BAR_RAISE-2026-07-29.md, no advance on barRaise.latestReportAt (frozen at 2026-07-28T12:05:00Z for two days), and no queue rows dated 2026-07-29. The scheduler cause is host-side and already owned by loop-tick-2026-07-29-barraise-runs-produce-no-output. The part that belongs to this project is that nothing here noticed: scripts/write-dashboard-status.ps1 kept publishing stale: false, because that flag is derived from release age and no signal is derived from review age at all. A silent daily review is worse than a noisy one, because every other finding on this page depends on the review actually running. Second, the published mirror got worse by one: X:\YesAndEverything\apothecary\CHANGELOG.md still reads v0.5.0 from 2026-05-18 beside a v1.1.4 pill, fifteen releases of drift, and deploy-to-yae.ps1 still has no policy for the file.

tensionsOpen.title: v1.1.4 drained the backlog on 2026-07-28 and the tree refilled with PROJECT_SPEC.md by 02:26 on 2026-07-30. Resolution: keep the chain read-only on releases but give the trigger an owner, either a docs-only-diff gated ship step at the end of the nightly audit or a weekly task. Six runs, well past the adr-promoter threshold.

Action 1 adds a signal that fires when a review is missed; the standing preference is a dashboard that does not cry wolf. Resolution: publish a field, not a banner. A boolean reading false on a healthy day costs nothing and makes a 49-hour gap addressable.

Mirroring only runtime files keeps the deploy fast, which is why CHANGELOG.md is not in the copy list. But the file is already tracked and published, so not-mirrored means there-and-permanently-stale. Two lines to add it, one commit to delete it.
Route saved-labels.js through ctx alone, leave autofit.js and print.js static with a note, add a graph check to the suite. At the promote threshold; promote via adr-promoter.

Re-measured this run: 43 of 199 over the 260 cap, range 261 to 317, 35 cut mid-word. Measure the 317-char record on the smallest template first, then pick, and make truncation word-aware regardless as a floor.

60 of 199 records still carry icon and migrate.js:181 backfills it so pre-v1.1 saved labels load. Resolution: stop writing icon and delete it from the records, keep normalizeState tolerant of it on read.
